tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search across published VI Update articles, Good Day, This Week editions, The Straight Record editions and VI Update's Papers (long-form reports from the public record), or one of them. Use for finding coverage of a person, place, agency or event. Each result has an id for fetch, a title, a URL with a story anchor where there is one, a snippet, a match tier (exact phrase, all words, some words) with the reason, and its own citeAs line; a Paper also carries its summary, its PDF link and its DOI where it has one. Papers are matched on their title and summary. Results are ranked by tier, then by whether the headline carries the match; across publications they take turns within a tier. Paging uses offset and next_offset. Facts are as of each item's date.

query.description: Words or a phrase, such as "WAPA rationing" or "Strait of Hormuz".

section.description: Limit to one publication: "vi_update", "good_day", "straight_record" or "papers" (VI Update's Papers). Default: all of them.

offset.description: How many ranked results to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one published item, by the id search or a list returns (such as "viupdate:<slug>", "goodday:036", "straightrecord:042" or "paper:<slug>") or by its public URL. Use for reading an article or edition before quoting or summarizing it. Returns up to 40,000 characters at a time inside a fence labeled as untrusted data; a longer item continues from next_offset. Metadata carries the date, the credit, the citeAs line and, for a VI Update article with a video, the Facebook link. A Paper is also found by its PDF link or its DOI. A Paper with a text edition (Markdown published beside the PDF) comes back as that text, served only when it matches the SHA-256 its listing gives, with the PDF as the version of record. Any other Paper comes back as its listing: the summary, the PDF and DOI links, the data behind it, its license and its citeAs line; this server does not read PDFs.

id.description: An id from search, latest or list_items, or the item's public URL; for a Paper, also its PDF link or DOI.

offset.description: Character position to start from, for the next window of a long item. Default 0.

tools.name: latest
tools.description: The newest published items: by default the newest VI Update articles, the newest Good Day, This Week edition and the newest Straight Record edition; or the newest items of one publication. Use for "what is new" or for current coverage. Each item has an id for fetch, its date, headlines or an excerpt, a URL and a citeAs line.

section.description: One publication: "vi_update", "good_day" or "straight_record". Default: all three.

limit.description: How many items per publication, 1 to 20. Default 5 for VI Update and 1 for each edition series when all three are asked for; 5 for one publication.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Published items of one publication, newest first, optionally between two dates, with paging. Use for browsing what a publication ran in a week, month or year. VI Update articles are dated by the date the article shows; Good Day and Straight Record editions by their publication date.

section.description: Which publication: "vi_update" (VI Update articles), "good_day" (Good Day, This Week editions) or "straight_record" (The Straight Record editions).

date_from.description: Earliest date, inclusive: a year (2026), a month (2026-10) or a day (2026-10-05).

date_to.description: Latest date, inclusive: a year, a month (its last day) or a day.

offset.description: How many items to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: get_good_day_edition
tools.description: One Good Day, This Week edition in full and in structure, by its number (such as "036" or "36"), or the newest when no number is given. Use for the week's stories with their sources, the tracked weekly items (WAPA, government, federal, infrastructure), By the Numbers and Also This Week. Good Day is an automated news digest and analysis, operated by Brian Louden, and each edition says so in its byline.

edition.description: Edition number, such as "036" or 36, or the edition URL. Default: the newest edition.

tools.name: get_straight_record_edition
tools.description: One Straight Record edition in full, by its id (such as "042", "42" or "P001", or the edition URL), or the newest when no id is given. Use for reading every story's The Gap, Left Said, Right Said and The Record (or The Record So Far), with sources, verbatim quotes and their attributions, per-story anchor URLs, Consensus Watch, and on Sundays the Claim of the Week and Democracy Watch. Facts are as of the edition date.

id.description: Edition id, such as "042" or "P001", or an edition URL. Default: the newest edition.

tools.name: claims_of_the_week
tools.description: The Claim of the Week fact check from Straight Record Sunday editions, newest first: the claim as quoted, who said it and when, the verdict and the analysis, with the edition date, URL and citeAs line. Use for what The Straight Record has fact-checked. Verdicts are the edition's assessment as of its date.

tools.name: about
tools.description: What this server holds: how many published items each publication has, the date range each covers, when the VI Update and Good Day data were last refreshed, how each publication is credited, and what is not included; also every published Paper by id, with its date, version, DOI and license. Use for questions about scope, or before reading an empty search as a gap in coverage.
